title: From Optimal Transport to Optimal Quantization: A Variational Study of the Witsenhausen Counterexample
summary: Witsenhausen's counterexample is a canonical problem in decentralized control: a two-stage linear-quadratic-Gaussian team problem in which nonlinear policies strictly outperform every affine one. This paper develops a variational and computational framework for the scalar counterexample based on optimal transport. Building on the transport formulation of Wu and Verdú, we absorb the first controller into a transport map and recast the problem as $J^\star=\inf_Q\{k^2W_2^2(P,Q)+\mathrm{mmse}(Q)\}$, which trades a quadratic Wasserstein transport cost against a minimum mean-square estimation…
